description: Full-text search of the Pennsylvania Code (state administrative regulations). Returns matching sections with citation, heading and a snippet. Use for "which Pennsylvania regulation covers X". Optional `title` restricts to one Code title (e.g. "25"). Pennsylvania Code regulations only; for statutes use pa_consolidated_statute. Keyless.

page.description: Result page, 1-based (10 results per page). Default 1.

query.description: Words or "quoted phrase" to find, e.g. "dam safety permit fees".

title.description: Optional Pennsylvania Code title number to restrict to, e.g. "25" or "55".

name: pa_code_search
title: Pa Code Search
